name: HD-2D diorama
summary: Pixel-art sprites stand in a 3D world built like a miniature model, seen from a high camera with strong depth of field, bloom and modern light. The world looks like a toy diorama lit at golden hour.

philosophy.core_thesis: Old pixel sprites inside modern light and depth of field read as a lovingly built miniature.
design_principles: Keep characters as 2D pixel sprites of 32–64 px.
Build the world in 3D with pixel-art textures on simple geometry.
Use a high, slightly tilted camera and strong depth of field: sharp middle, blurred top and bottom.
Light with modern dynamic light: lamps, bloom and soft shadows.
Add particles: dust, embers, light shafts.
Grade toward warm golden hours or deep blue nights.
anti_patterns: A flat 2D view with no depth
Sharp focus across the whole frame

projection_and_camera.camera: High fixed or slow-tracking camera, tilted down 30–45°.
projection_and_camera.framing: A miniature view: rooftops and streets in frame, sharp band in the middle.

geometry.primitive: Pixel sprites on billboards in a simple 3D mesh world.
geometry.budget: Low-to-mid poly world; 2D sprites of 32–64 px.
geometry.edge_rule: Pixel edges on sprites; smooth 3D edges blurred by depth of field.
geometry.proportion: Miniature: chunky buildings and small figures.

surface.texture_rule: Pixel-art textures on 3D geometry, with modern normal maps on some surfaces.
surface.texel_density: about 32–64 px for each metre on pixel faces
surface.filtering: Nearest on sprites; smooth on 3D surfaces.
surface.material_model: Modern lit materials with pixel-art albedo.

palette.strategy: Warm, saturated golden light against deep blue shadows; colour comes from the light.

lighting.model: Real-time dynamic light with bloom and point lights.
lighting.shadows: Soft dynamic shadows from lamps and the sun.
lighting.atmosphere: Depth of field, bloom, light shafts, dust and embers.
lighting.time_of_day: Golden hour, lantern-lit night or a misty dawn.

world_and_space.scale: Miniature: a street fits in the frame like a model.
world_and_space.interiors: Rooms seen from above at an angle, warm lamps, pixel furniture.
world_and_space.exteriors: Town squares with fountains, steps and rooftops in a tilt-shift view.
world_and_space.threshold: A fade to a room scene.

principles.rule: Blur the top and bottom bands; keep a sharp middle band of about 30% of the height.
Use 3 layers: golden key, blue ambient, warm lamp points.
Light the player area with the warmest light.
Make buildings chunky and figures small, as in a 1:87 model.

interface.placement: Framed boxes and menus on the sides, 10–20% of the screen.

emotion.target_response: Tender nostalgia: the viewer sees a precious miniature world in warm light.

avoid_when: The client needs a true-to-life image.

modifiers.how: Drop the 3D and the depth of field; keep the sprites and parallax.
Replace the sprites with 3D figures and physical materials.
